diagnosis.summary: The nightly run for 2026-10-01 (b2123bbc) failed at ingest because orders.csv arrived with an extra column, coupon_code, that isn't in the contract. All the contract columns are present and unchanged. I've proposed one fix: ignore coupon_code for raw.orders at ingest, then rerun. The harness will apply and check it. Upstream didn't announce the change, so it's worth telling the upstream app team.

root_cause.explanation: Upstream added a trailing coupon_code column to orders.csv starting 2026-10-01. Ingest checks the file header strictly, and the ingest config is empty, so the unexpected column fails the load. The 7 contract columns keep their names, order and formats, the row count is normal, and the other landing tables match their contracts.

evidence.claim: The ingest step failed with a schema mismatch on raw.orders: no missing columns, one unexpected column, coupon_code.
The 2026-10-01 orders.csv has every contract column, matching 09-30, plus a trailing coupon_code. Formats and row count are normal.
The other 10-01 landing files match their contracts.
The ingest config has no rules, so nothing currently handles the extra column.
The runbook says to ignore a purely additive non-contract column at ingest, and to escalate only if contract columns were dropped or a metric's meaning changes.

alternatives_considered: request_upstream_redelivery: rejected. The file is complete and valid, and the new column looks deliberate rather than a one-off delivery problem.
column_renamed: ruled out because no contract columns are missing.
escalate_to_owner (upstream_app_team): not needed for an additive column under the runbook, though it's worth telling them the change wasn't announced.
A bad model deploy: ruled out because the failure happens at ingest, before any dbt model runs.

proposal.rationale: Upstream added one non-contract column, coupon_code, to the end of orders.csv. All 7 contract columns are still there with the same names, order and formats. Nothing is missing and the other tables are clean. The runbook says a purely additive column should be ignored at ingest, not handled by redelivery or escalation. Ignoring coupon_code lets raw.orders load the 2026-10-01 data unchanged.

applied: ingest now ignores upstream columns ['coupon_code'] on raw.orders
